question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

____ each other's hands; otherwise, you will fall.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Hold.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hold"** means to grasp, carry, or support with one's hands or arms. (पकड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **Please hold my hand while crossing the street.
 
 
 
• In this context, **"Hold"** refers to maintaining a grasp on something to prevent it from slipping or falling.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Hold**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Carry **(ले जाना): To support and move (someone or something) from one place to another.

 
 
• **Example:** Please carry the groceries into the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **Keep **(रखना): To have or retain possession of.
 
 
• **Example: **Keep the keys in a safe place.
 
 
 
• **Clap** (ताली बजाना): To strike the palms of (one's hands) together repeatedly, typically in order to applaud.
 
 
• **Example:** The audience began to clap after the performance.
